Name: Bugs in the valley
Author: HitaxasTV
Description:
Bugs in the valley currently contains 51 unique bugs, ranging from the black ant, to spiders and more ( though, a large number are beetles and butterflies ). 

Where and when bugs spawn are as closely based on their real-world counterparts as much as possible, with most of them being able to be found during the seasons of spring-fall. 

Some you will find on the ground as forage, some you will find when shaking a bush or a tree, some have to be dug up and some (currently one) can be fished up. Explore the world and find them all!

These bugs can be donated to Gunther at the museum, where he can tell you more about each species. ( I highly recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19143]Gunther Tells You[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120865633]emurphy42[/url], and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23721]Extra Museum Space[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/126625398]RaffieJohn[/url]﻿ )

[b]Upcoming features:[/b]

More Mail! This mail will be delivered to the player the day after donating certain bugs to the museum. The mail may include some small reward items for donating, and there may or may not be a very special reward for turning all of them in!


Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/47290403]Seiyn[/url] for allowing me to use some of the sprites from their old [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8565]Insect Valley[/url] mod.
